title: Add a bubble containing audio volume percentage, like the optional battery percentage bubble
line: The Audio Volume widget can now show the current volume percentage in a small badge on its icon, like the battery widget.
explanation: The battery widget has an optional percentage badge on its tray icon (a context menu toggle backed by its showPercentage setting and the shared BadgeOverlay component), but the Audio Volume widget had nothing similar, so the volume level was only visible in the tooltip or popup. The change adds a showPercentage setting (off by default) to the volume applet, a checkable "Show volume percentage on icon" entry in its context menu, and the same BadgeOverlay on the compact icon showing the default output's volume; the badge hides when the output is muted or there is no real output.

commits.message:
applet: add an option to show the volume percentage on the icon

The battery widget can show its charge percentage in a small badge on
its icon, but the volume widget had no equivalent. Add a checkable
context menu entry that shows the current volume in the same badge.

BUG: 411972

patches.diff:
From 92deb1d08c72f4bfafc65d0fccecf61bf0b6a1bc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 19:27:40 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applet: add an option to show the volume percentage on the
 icon

The battery widget can show its charge percentage in a small badge on
its icon, but the volume widget had no equivalent. Add a checkable
context menu entry that shows the current volume in the same badge.

BUG: 411972
---
 applet/main.qml | 32 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 applet/main.xml |  4 ++++
 2 files changed, 36 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applet/main.qml b/applet/main.qml
index 1e44cded..67c15359 100644
--- a/applet/main.qml
+++ b/applet/main.qml
@@ -14,6 +14,7 @@ import org.kde.kitemmodels as KItemModels
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PC3
 import org.kde.plasma.extras as PlasmaExtras
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
+import org.kde.plasma.workspace.components as WorkspaceComponents
 
 import org.kde.kcmutils as KCMUtils
 import org.kde.config as KConfig
@@ -260,10 +261,34 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             }
         }
         Kirigami.Icon {
+            id: compactIcon
             anchors.fill: parent
             source: plasmoid.icon
             active: parent.containsMouse
         }
+
+        WorkspaceComponents.BadgeOverlay {
+            id: badge
+
+            anchors.right: parent.right
+            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
+
+            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage && PreferredDevice.sink && !main.isDummyOutput(PreferredDevice.sink) && !PreferredDevice.sink.muted
+
+            text: i18nc("volume percentage below volume icon", "%1%", main.volumePercent(PreferredDevice.sink?.volume ?? 0))
+
+            // Non-default state to center if the badge is wider than the icon
+            states: [
+                State {
+                    when: badge.width >= compactIcon.width
+                    AnchorChanges {
+                        target: badge
+                        anchors.right: undefined
+                        anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
+                    }
+                }
+            ]
+        }
     }
 
     VolumeFeedback {
@@ -782,6 +807,13 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             checkable: true
             checked: plasmoid.configuration.showVirtualDevices
             onTriggered: Plasmoid.configuration.showVirtualDevices = !Plasmoid.configuration.showVirtualDevices
+        },
+        PlasmaCore.Action {
+            text: i18n("Show volume percentage on icon")
+            icon.name: "format-number-percent"
+            checkable: true
+            checked: Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage
+            onTriggered: Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage = !Plasmoid.configuration.showPercentage
         }
     ]
 
diff --git a/applet/main.xml b/applet/main.xml
index 54bf8518..c51d5f7d 100644
--- a/applet/main.xml
+++ b/applet/main.xml
@@ -41,6 +41,10 @@
     <entry name="showVirtualDevices" type="Bool">
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="showPercentage" type="Bool">
+      <label>Whether to show the volume percentage on the icon</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="migrated" type="Bool">
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Before: the volume icon in the tray has no percentage.
After, with the option on: the volume icon shows 65% in the same badge style as the battery widget.
Before: the volume widget's context menu has no percentage option.
After: new checkable "Show volume percentage on icon" entry in the context menu.
Before: the icon looks the same at any volume.
After: the badge follows the volume live (100%, 7%) and hides while muted.
